card.name: Linking words before monitoring or evaluation triggers
card.fires_on: Small linking words (when, with, if, should, a comma) in warnings that say to evaluate or test a patient once a symptom or finding appears. The next words name the symptom that triggers the check.

modes.label: Evaluate for X when
modes.description: The word 'when' or 'with' right after an instruction to evaluate for a condition.
modes.example: Evaluate for pancreatitis<< when>> lipase elevation is accompanied by abdominal symptoms

modes.label: Exam or test if symptoms occur
modes.description: A linking word or comma before a conditional instruction to examine or test.
modes.example: Complete blood counts should be performed promptly<< if>> the patient develops any signs of infection (

card.writes: It makes the model more likely to continue with a list of symptoms or findings, and less with words about suspicion or doubt.
card.plain: It fires on the small word that introduces the symptom which should prompt a check or evaluation.
